description: Pull the current state and assignee of this company's open tickets (max 50 per call, time-boxed). Returns {checked, changed, errors, remaining}; remaining > 0 means call again to continue. Error codes: permission_missing, role_missing, destination_not_found, already_filed, rate_limited, assignee_unmapped, no_route, no_entry, not_found, invalid, no_company, tracker_error, filed_unrecorded, outcome_unknown, not_attempted, not_configured, tracker_unreachable, unsupported. filed_unrecorded and outcome_unknown mean the ticket may already exist in the tracker; not_attempted means the item was not sent.
name: sync_threat_tickets
title: Sync ticket status now
